alex-cs: FYI — BlueCrest Medical (renewal Q2) submitted a formal request to onboard a custom 13B visit-summarizer into Private (VPC). Key asks: HSM-backed keys, strict PHI redaction on ingest, zero-log export, and SOC access to canary metrics. They said delay >4 weeks jeopardizes renewal. Can we scope?
nina-se: Got it. Do we have their model artifact + license? Also need explicit data residency statement and acceptable PHI categories list.
alex-cs: They attached onboarding packet: https://files.redwood/bluecrest/onboard (artifact link included). Quote from customer: "trained on US EMR visit notes, cannot persist raw patient text outside VPC, require KMS in customer's account or HSM usage, and need PII redaction with >=95% recall".
omar-ml: For safety/evals I suggest: PHI-leakage sweep, redaction recall/precision on 400 labeled spans, 250 adversarial prompts, and 500 generation regen checks for hallucination rate. Also recommend an offline differential privacy check for training traces.
nina-se: Operational notes: Private+bring-your-own-KMS will need infra/RBAC mapping and network peering. Also confirm target latency — they want median <250ms @ 256 tokens. Any negotiation room?\alex-cs: BlueCrest said "250ms median is non-negotiable for our clinician UI" but can accept a staged ramp with 72hr canary if we expose metrics to their SOC.
pat-infra: We'll need the customer KMS ARN, VPC CIDR, and list of IPs for peering. Also need infra approval for HSM usage and a security review ticket.
ops-bot: ticket CS-6007 created: BlueCrest 13B private onboarding + HSM + PHI evals. https://issues.redwood/CS-6007
ina-se: I'll draft a short runbook: preflight checklist (model artifact hash, KMS ARN, network diag), deployment steps, canary gating rules (error budget <1%, latency median <260ms during canary), rollback criteria.
omar-ml: I'll assemble eval dataset and runner. Proposed deliverables before kickoff: redaction test vectors, leakage report template, and eval dashboard.
ryan-sales: Noted renewal risk. I'll sync contract team to extend a narrow SLA window contingent on canary signoff. Also will prep customer enablement invite.
alex-cs: Can we schedule a 60min kickoff Wed 9am PT? Need infra + ML + SE there.
pat-infra: Wed 9am PT works for infra. I'll bring the HSM usage checklist and required approvals.
nina-se: I'll lead the session and cover prechecks. Please drop any network/KMS items into CS-6007 before Tue EOD.
omar-ml: Posting initial redaction sample vectors here tomorrow.
alex-cs: Thank you — priority HIGH. Goal: have canary plan, infra signoffs, and eval harness ready by Tue EOD so we can start canary Thurs. :raised_hands:
